s1.syndrome_frame: A subcutaneous mass with recent growth and tenderness on the lower leg
salient_findings: Painful nodule on the lower part of the right leg
Enlargement and tenderness of the lesion over the past 6 months
Irregular, firm, erythematous, mobile, tender mass
key_facts: 40-year-old man
Lesion initially stable in size and painless for 4 years
No history of trauma
No personal or family history of malignancy
Mass measuring 3.5 × 2.3 × 1.7 cm
No popliteal or inguinal lymphadenopathy
Normal routine blood tests
Negative tests for hepatitis B surface antigen and HIV
Lobulated, tan-gray, firm mass on gross examination
Dermal tumor extending into the superficial subcutis
Nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells on light microscopy
Strong positivity for vimentin and focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45 on immunohistochemical staining

shortlist.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
shortlist.why_kept: matches description of a subcutaneous mass with recent growth and tenderness on the lower leg, and immunohistochemical staining shows strong positivity for vimentin

shortlist.label: Epithelioid sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: shows nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells on light microscopy, consistent with case findings

shortlist.label: Pleomorphic undifferentiated sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: case presentation of a rapidly growing subcutaneous mass with atypical mitotic figures is consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Liposarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: although less likely, cannot be ruled out without further testing, given the presence of a subcutaneous mass

shortlist.label: Leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: possible diagnosis given the spindle-shaped cells, but less likely due to lack of specific immunohistochemical markers

shortlist.label: Malignant fibrous histiocytoma
shortlist.why_kept: now considered a subtype of undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma, but still a possible diagnosis

shortlist.label: Myxofibrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: a type of sarcoma that can present as a subcutaneous mass, although the case findings are not as strongly suggestive of this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: broad category that includes several types of sarcomas, and the case presentation is consistent with this diagnosis

raw.rationale: The tumor's location on the lower part of the leg, its initial stability in size and painlessness for 4 years followed by enlargement and tenderness, and the histological features of nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with strong positivity for vimentin and focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45 are consistent with Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans.

rejected.label: Epithelioid sarcoma
rejected.why: Typically presents with more aggressive behavior and often involves the distal extremities, especially the hands, with a higher rate of lymph node metastasis.

rejected.label: Pleomorphic undifferentiated sarcoma
rejected.why: Usually exhibits a more pleomorphic and undifferentiated morphology, with a higher mitotic rate and more atypical forms, and lacks the specific immunohistochemical staining pattern seen in this case.

rejected.label: Liposarcoma
rejected.why: Would typically show evidence of lipogenic differentiation and may have a different growth pattern, often with a larger size at presentation and less tendency to be confined to the dermis and subcutis.

rejected.label: Leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: Typically shows more pronounced smooth muscle differentiation and would be expected to express smooth muscle markers, which were not mentioned in the case.

rejected.label: Malignant fibrous histiocytoma
rejected.why: Now considered part of the spectrum of undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcomas and would be expected to show a more storiform or cartwheel pattern and a lack of the specific immunohistochemical profile seen in this case.

rejected.label: Myxofibrosarcoma
rejected.why: Characterized by a prominent myxoid component and typically lacks the distinct lobulated, tan-gray appearance and the specific immunohistochemical staining pattern of this tumor.

rejected.label: Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma
rejected.why: Lacks specific differentiation and would not be expected to show the particular pattern of immunohistochemical staining seen in this case, with strong positivity for vimentin and focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45.
